name: Hemanth
intro: I build offensive security tools, OSINT workflows, network analysis tools, and secure local-first applications. My work spans vulnerability scanning, recon automation, cryptography, password security, and CTF challenges. I also contribute to cybersecurity communities through design, branding, event infrastructure, and club-led initiatives.

projects.name: Aegis
projects.description: A local SOC and deception lab that ingests Cowrie telemetry, tracks incidents, explains detections, and exports evidence-linked analyst reports.

projects.name: ThrustGuard
projects.description: IoT behavioral trust scoring with policy rules, statistical drift checks, anomaly detection, hash-chained audit logs, and LLM-assisted incident reports.

projects.name: SpecterNet
projects.description: A network analysis tool with live packet capture, HTTP/FTP/Telnet/SMTP inspection, traffic visualization, plaintext credential detection, and threaded port scanning.

projects.name: SentinelX
projects.summary: From source code to security findings.
projects.description: AST-based Python scanning and secret detection, with AI-assisted attack paths, proof-of-concept payloads, and impact summaries for security research.

projects.name: PhantomEye
projects.description: Concurrent OSINT checks across 100+ platforms, with username, email, IP, domain, and phone modules, DNS and security-header checks, and HTML reports.

projects.name: SafeKey
projects.description: A local-first password manager with AES-256-GCM vault encryption, PBKDF2 key derivation, per-entry IVs, clipboard timeout, inactivity auto-lock, and password strength feedback. Supports browser, desktop, and Android distribution.

projects.name: CipherX
projects.description: Multi-layer cipher and encoding detection with Base64, hex, ROT13, Morse and more. Includes Caesar, XOR and Vigenere workflows, flag scoring, steganography, and hash identification.

projects.name: RoadSOS
projects.summary: From crash detection to emergency response.
projects.description: National Road Safety Hackathon 2026 project using a TFLite sensor model, OpenStreetMap road checks, a two-step cancel flow, emergency calls and SMS, realtime bystander alerts, and first-aid guidance.

projects.name: Cyventura CTF Platform
projects.description: A weekly CTF platform with authentication, challenges, flag submissions, leaderboards, events, and admin tools. Includes hashed passwords and flags, rate limiting, and upload validation.

projects.name: CTF-AI
projects.summary: A companion for the learning curve.
projects.description: An AI-assisted CTF learning tool designed to help beginners reason through challenge concepts and build problem-solving confidence.

projects.name: SpecFit
projects.description: A Flask system health dashboard using psutil to track CPU and memory, classify NORMAL, STRAINED, and OVERLOADED states, identify top memory consumers, and explain conditions with Groq.

projects.name: GHOST
projects.description: A modular local assistant concept built around distinct workflow modes and configurable model support.

projects.name: Yugma
projects.description: A platform concept for connecting college clubs and making inter-college coordination easier.

projects.name: AttendQR
projects.description: A QR-based attendance project built around a lightweight web application and a SQLite fallback.

projects.name: nmapx
projects.summary: Network scans, live in the browser.
projects.description: A web interface for Nmap with WebSocket output streaming, readable scan summaries, scan profiles, and Groq-assisted threat analysis.

projects.name: CertFlow
projects.description: A Flask certificate generator with participant lists, template previews, layout controls, and batch ZIP exports for college and event workflows. Also known as Certs-Automator.

projects.name: ChessForge
projects.summary: A chessboard you can make your own.
projects.description: A custom chess platform with move validation, endgame detection, a board editor, themes, and Chess960 with castling support.

projects.name: GhostC2
projects.summary: A modular console for authorized labs.
projects.description: Python C2 framework for CTFs and authorized penetration testing, with multi-session management, payload generation, listeners, file transfer, system information, and session cleanup.

projects.name: ScanForge
projects.description: A modular Python web scanner with link and form crawling, checks for SQL injection, XSS, local file inclusion, open redirects and missing security headers, plus JSON and HTML reports.

projects.name: AI CLI
projects.description: A dependency-free Python assistant unifying 10 providers and 100+ models, with interactive chat, piped input, provider and model listings, and model switching mid-chat.

projects.name: steg-art
projects.summary: An image with a hidden message.
projects.description: An image pipeline using Groq prompt enhancement and FLUX.1-schnell through Hugging Face, with LSB message embedding in PNGs and encode/decode APIs.

projects.name: snipe
projects.description: A Telegram bot scanning RSS, DuckDuckGo, and CTFtime every 30 minutes. Uses Groq filtering and SQLite preferences and deduplication for hackathons, internships, CTFs, and other opportunities.

projects.name: UI Album
projects.description: A React and Vite component gallery exploring timelines, dashboards, heroes, forms, docks, grids, and other reusable interface patterns.

projects.name: 3D Portfolio Website
projects.summary: An interactive showcase in three dimensions.
projects.description: A React portfolio with a custom 3D keyboard, particles, elastic cursor, and scroll-driven animation, built with Three.js, React Three Fiber, Spline, GSAP, and Framer Motion.

projects.name: flappy-bird
projects.summary: A browser game in a single file.
projects.description: A lightweight HTML and JavaScript Flappy Bird implementation that runs directly in the browser without an install step.

projects.name: snake_game
projects.summary: Play your way to the flag.
projects.description: A Java Snake game with separate rendering, controller, and model layers. Each apple earns 400 points; reaching 4000 points reveals a CTF flag.

projects.name: Procedural Font Foundry
projects.description: Four original fonts—CypherDiamond, QuantumMono, NovaGrid, and Etherence—generated mathematically in Python, with TTF outputs and a preview and download landing page.
